verdict.rationale: Installed plugins add skills and MCP tools to chats, and Codex/ChatGPT load a skill's full instructions when the model decides it is relevant (docs-45, docs-49). Plugins are used conversationally, for example to summarize Slack channels or draft replies (docs-4), and community users confirm explicit invocation in plain language such as "use the PR skill to open a PR" (comm-8). Skill creation itself is conversational: the creator asks what the skill should do, and the recorder drafts a skill from a demonstration (docs-7, docs-16). missing for 10: plugin install and management run through slash commands, `$` mentions or a UI browser rather than free-form natural language (docs-25, docs-20); no hands-on probe of natural-language invocation; documented end-to-end natural-language command examples are thin.
